summary: The user rejected AppContainer/profile creation and Windows-specific test code, and directed a bounded direct process trial. Controlled Git/no-Git fixture CLI init and native MCP succeeded with only observed in-fixture .codegraph additions and unchanged source/config/hooks; the CLI offered optional hook sync even on no-Git input. The accepted plan and T015 hard gate require effective OS child ACL/network confinement, which direct execution does not prove. Reconcile the selected process-risk/qualification strategy at plan before marking T015 or app-bound work complete. Preserve spec source immutability, trusted model/root separation, Story 18.2 shared contract, live authority, cancellation, no arbitrary workspace, review/approval history and recovery count2. No blanket OS isolation claim or waiver arises from the direct fixture observation.
